title: Glowing trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M62 32 L86 21 Q88 32 86 43 L62 47 Z' fill='#FFB300'/>

  <ellipse cx='88' cy='32' rx='2' ry='9' fill='#FF9800'/>

  <path d='M90 10 L94 4' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M96 20 L99 17' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M96 44 L99 47' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M90 54 L94 60' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='48' y='34' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>

  <rect x='52' y='24' width='6' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#FFB300'/>

  <rect x='43' y='22' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFF3C4'/>

  <rect x='59' y='22' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <!-- leadpipe and mouthpiece to the left -->
  <path d='M48 40 L30 40 L26 38' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 38 L30 38 L27 37' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='37' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='37' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- finger ring -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
